verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms LiveKit serves an llms.txt at docs.livekit.io/llms.txt, and its first-party docs describe a Docs MCP server and agent-oriented skills and docs meant to make coding agents LiveKit experts. That directly delivers agent-pointable documentation. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of how well agents use these resources (the root /.md probe returned 404, though individual .md doc pages exist).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
